Eila the Sandwoman

Biography

Eila left the village hoping to learn magic, but Estera rejected her. After an unsuccessful stay with the brigands she found a place among Shei-Var’s orcs, fighting in return for magical instruction. She can join Zak in the Sands and later considers using his example to encourage peace between the orcs and the village. [1, 2, 3]
